evidence.source: Guarded Production rollout run 31565613954 applied contracts 175 to 178 from exact main f85b18e54e7e23b5cc387520cd86280d3df47507, after its own API check that backup run 31562346500 and rehearsal run 31565189247 had both concluded success, and after a dry run that asserted the four migration files BY NAME with diff rather than by count. All four are ADDITIVE, so check-migration-additive.mjs ran as a GATE rather than as a report; a reader who finds that softened back to a report should stop, because the boundary has changed. THE REHEARSAL EARNED ITS PLACE AND IS WORTH RECORDING: its first dispatch, run 31563535872, applied all four migrations to the disposable target cleanly and then FAILED on its own postflight, because euro_publication_state() returns a table of (state, changed_at) rather than jsonb and the probe read it as ->> 'state'. The identical probe was in the rollout, where it would have fired AFTER Production had been written -- a green apply followed by a red verification, which is the hardest state to reason about at speed. Nothing would have been wrong with Production; the evidence that it was fine would simply have been missing. Both files were corrected and the rehearsal re-run to success before the rollout was dispatched at all. THE PROPERTY THIS BOUNDARY EXISTS TO PUT IN PRODUCTION is contract 178's independence, and it is read off the INSTALLED definition rather than trusted from the migration's own source assertion, which are different claims: predictor_internal.shadow_matchweek_points names NEITHER season_fixture_points NOR season_matchweek_points, so the shadow verifier cannot agree with the scoring path by construction; predictor_internal.season_matchweek_projection DOES name season_fixture_points, so contract 175's projection reuses the ADR 0012 authority rather than restating it; and save_season_predictions_batch reaches save_season_prediction while inserting into season_predictions nowhere, so contract 177 added no second write path. Confirmed by the postflight on the live target: the ledger NAMES 20260812000000, 20260812001000, 20260812002000 and 20260812003000, the total is 178 and the latest is shadow_scoring_verifier. Naming the rows rather than counting them is deliberate and was learned on 11 August 2026, when a select count(*) against a hosted ledger returned a stale value for roughly twenty-five minutes after a successful apply while a row-level query returned the truth immediately. GRANTS, measured: the five new public functions exist; run_shadow_scoring_verification is reachable by NO browser role, being a job rather than an action; the other four are reachable by authenticated and resolve their boundaries internally, with admin_shadow_scoring_report refusing inside on require_competition_admin(); and NO anonymous role reaches any of the five. The two new relations, predictor_internal.shadow_scoring_runs and shadow_scoring_mismatches, carry row-level security, are granted to no browser role and hold ZERO rows on apply. IT SCHEDULED NOTHING, and that is the claim most worth checking on this range: cron.job holds TEN jobs before and after, compared rather than asserted against an absolute, and NO scheduled command names run_shadow_scoring_verification. Contract 178's verifier therefore has no caller in Production and generates nothing until one is given, which is a separate decision. It also corrects nothing by construction -- a disagreement is recorded as evidence and the verifier has no authority over a banked total. Nothing player-owned moved: 1 auth user, 1 profile, 3 entries, 578 season fixtures, 16 season predictions, 36 match predictions and 2 player action items are all unchanged, and every count captured before the apply was compared after it. This is SCHEMA ONLY and claims nothing further. It did not publish Euro 2028 -- euro_publication_state() still returns hidden, publication is an owner act and EURO-001 remains a recorded defect. It launched no competition, drew no Championship and opened no Last Man Standing. It confirmed no provider result, added or voided no fixture, and imported no football. Application promotion is separately controlled and is NOT claimed by this record.
